structural_change: r4 (new kit; RTL 320d5b77d byte-identical). History: r2 194.4x324 gate WARN util 5%, W half empty, clock ~150 um from sinks (TT insertion 293.8 ps). r3 a77910722 86.4x151.2 (PPL ordered 32-pin groups, E M2+M4, N M3+M5; gate util 26%, TT insertion 174.9/spread 22.3 ps) routed to EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION GRT-0116 at 5_1_grt: total usage only 32% (M2 41/M3 43/M4 19/M5 21%), overflow 2,016 in 867 gcells, max 4 over ~18 per gcell; hot windows = the E pin hold-stage band (x 79-83 um, y 20-60 and 85-150 um; srcs e_d + ot_inhold/ot_ihdrv nets, horizontal) and the N band (y 138-148 um; s_d + ot_outhold nets, horizontal), worst gcell at the NE corner where the E and N bands meet. Cause: PPL packs each 32-pin group at slot pitch and stacks both pin layers at the same y (~20 pins/um local, gaps elsewhere), 13.6 pins/um average on E. r4 fix: route.pin_balance (uniform place_pin, layer alternating every pin) and a larger outline. Gate trial at 108x259.2 (util 12%, E 3.96 pins/um/layer) REJECTED on its images: the logic (2,048-bit e_d capture -> lane512 mux -> r_q -> 4 pad stages -> N outputs) gathers toward the N face, so the bottom half of a tall E face carried only the pin flops with ~250 um wires up to the mux; SW 60% empty; TT insertion 233.9 / spread 56.6 ps. Chosen 108x172.8 (5 x 21.6, 8 x 21.6) = 18,662 um2 (r3 13,064, r2 62,986), std 3,183 um2 -> util ~17%: E 2,052 / 172.8 um = 11.9 pins/um face, uniform = 5.94 per layer M2/M4 (r3 PPL peak ~20 pins/um stacked -> -40%); N 1,028 / 108 um = 9.52 pins/um face = 4.76 per layer M3/M5 (r3 11.9 -> -20%). Bounded by the r3 gate trial at 129.6x151.2 (W 40% empty) on width and by the 259.2 trial on height. Clock: W-face centre (ck at 86.0-86.8 um of 172.8, rn adjacent, return_valid/lane just below, explicit pin_ranges), 108 um from the E pin column, <= 194 um Manhattan to any sink, never a corner. tq[1] sync-clear fan-out (~4.1k loads on r_q/pad) left in RTL (frozen, proven source); buffered by repair_design.
